title: DXF Flange Cover Pressure Analysis
generation_method: Native automation APIs were executed inside the mapped Windows Snapshot against the installed AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, and Abaqus applications. AutoCAD saved the DXF, SOLIDWORKS imported that exact DXF and exported the STEP, and Abaqus imported that exact STEP, built the model, submitted the job, and wrote the CAE/ODB. No offline or simulated GT geometry/results were used.

generated_files.hash_note: Authoritative real-software model regenerated to request U, S, RF, NFORC, and CF in Step-Pressure; the final Snapshot download matched this hash exactly.
Authoritative completed real-software result with NFORC1/2/3, RF, S, and U; CF is absent because no concentrated load is applied.

abaqus_audit.bolt_hole_faces_note: The imported topology splits each of the eight complete through-hole walls into two half-cylinder faces.

validation.returncode_convention: All evaluator invocations returned process code 0 and wrote the semantic Boolean to eval_result.txt.
validation.isolation_protocol: Before every case, all four Desktop deliverables were independently restored from the named fixture set; no CAE session or modified file state was reused across cases, and all /execute calls were serial.

positive_cases.case: native real-software GT with force outputs
suppressed coupling object retained as an inactive modeling artifact
BOLT_HOLES defined by the exact constrained nodes instead of faces
complete native CAD-to-STEP-to-CAE chain with the eight-hole pattern rotated by 22.5 degrees
complete native chain with reference circles represented on a construction layer
Abaqus dependent instance translated and rotated by a valid rigid transform
native multi-cell partitioned flange with a valid first-order mesh
authoritative native GT restored after all negative cases

evaluator_hardening: DXF geometry is semantically expanded from AutoCAD model space with ezdxf, so block references are accepted and paper-space-only decoys are ignored.
STEP geometry is parsed through CadQuery and checked for one solid, exact volume, eight D6 through holes, and the D50 x 2 mm blind recess.
The Abaqus part volume and named-face topology are checked independently against the validated STEP geometry while allowing legitimate native partitions.
CAE and ODB mesh node coordinates, element types, labels, connectivity, material assignment, and exact named-region membership must match.
Boundary conditions and loads are replayed step by step with native OP=NEW and OP=MOD semantics; inactive objects are accepted but extra active analysis actions are rejected.
Positive pressure is checked in CAE and the generated INP, while signed pressure-face NFORC1/2/3 and bolt-hole RF bind the completed ODB to the requested load direction and regions.
Distributed pressure may legitimately produce no CF field, but any nonzero concentrated-force output on the flange is rejected.
Reasonable equivalents include exact nodal bolt sets, construction-layer reference circles, rigidly transformed dependent instances, and partitioned first-order meshes.
